{{Infobox auto}}

'''Bread''' is baked [[dough]]. It heals {{Hp|4}} and removes harmful effects ("Cleanse Maleffect"), which makes it a cheap cure for the [[Wither effect]] and poison.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/bread.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Dough bakes into bread in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. The vanilla recipe from wheat is removed. In a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]], dough becomes [[naan]] instead.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating bread takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|4}} and removes Poison, Mining Fatigue, Wither, Weakness, Bad Omen, Blindness, Darkness, Infested, Weaving, Nausea, Oozing and Slowness.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/bread.json}}</ref> The developer asks players to bring milk or bread to [[Hell]].<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=Please bring milk or bread to Hell, please its very important}}</ref>

Obtaining bread unlocks [[French Toast|French toast]]. Bread is used in [[bruschetta]], [[French Toast|French toast]], [[Honied French Toast|honied French toast]], [[Sweet Berry Toast|sweet berry toast]], [[latke]]s and [[Ice Cream|ice cream]]. [[Naan]] can be used in its place.
